result.plain_summary: You received a hospital bill and an Explanation of Benefits for emergency room services on September 14, 2026. The total billed amount was $9,149.50. Your health insurance processed the claim and paid $1,691.70 to the hospital. Your insurance calculated that your personal share is $808.85 based on your deductible, copay, and coinsurance. However, the hospital bill asks for $1,563.35 because it appears to charge you for supplies and a duplicate lab test that insurance disallowed. You should contact the hospital billing office before paying to ensure you are only billed for your $808.85 insurance responsibility.
